name: Liferun
verdict: Liferun's biggest movement this week is a 50% drop in leads alongside a 35.43% pullback in spend, pointing to reduced Meta budget as the likely driver since Google Ads generated zero conversions across the full 28-day window despite $1,239.78 in spend. Rebalancing budget toward Meta, which delivered all 130 leads at a $19.85 CPL, and investigating Google's conversion tracking should be the immediate priority.

performance.verdict: Google burning $1,240 with zero conversions; Meta CPL rising fast.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $1,239.78 over 28 days and recorded zero conversions; top campaign 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' alone consumed $930.24 with no measurable return.
Meta CPL rose 29.14% week-over-week while leads fell 50%; 3-day signal (Aug 15–17: 0+0+2 leads vs Aug 12–14: 9+5+4) confirms the deterioration is not noise.
SOW milestone 'Stripe Products QA'd & Done' (due 2026-07-20) shows no completed verification event in GHL data — money paths unconfirmed 29 days overdue.
GHL shows 133 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments; 130 ad leads arrived yet pipeline value is $0 — intake is receiving leads but activation is stalling.
GBP actions fell 50% week-over-week to near zero (0 actions Aug 15–17); with 0 calls logged across 28 days, organic call-intent is effectively absent.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads spend immediately; shift $50/day to Meta until Google conversion tracking is verified working.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $1,239.78 over 28 days with zero recorded conversions; Meta delivered all 130 leads at a $19.85 CPL but CPL is now rising 29.14% week-over-week as budget dried up. Pause the Google campaigns and redirect approximately $50/day to Meta to stabilise lead volume while the Google pixel/call-tracking is diagnosed. Success check: Meta CPL returns below $20 within 7 days (by 2026-08-25) and Google conversion tracking is confirmed firing before any Google budget is restored.

suggestions.text: Verify Google Ads call-conversion pixel is firing; confirm BWS Search campaign call extensions are linked to a tracked number.
suggestions.monday_update: The 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' campaign spent $930.24 of the $1,239.78 Google total with zero conversions recorded — this is almost certainly a tracking gap, not zero calls. Audit the Google Ads call conversion action and confirm the forwarding number is active and linked. Success check: at least one conversion event recorded in Google Ads within 3 days of the fix (by 2026-08-21); if still zero after that, escalate to client-side pixel review.

suggestions.text: Complete overdue Stripe/Becklar/BWS verification tasks; 133 GHL opps at $0 value signals intake leak losing activated-subscriber revenue.
suggestions.monday_update: The Stripe Products QA milestone was due 2026-07-20 and remains unverified; GHL shows 133 opportunities created with $0 pipeline value and 0 appointments, meaning leads are entering but not converting to activated subscribers. Run the dummy Becklar deactivation test and the BWS duplicate-order check per the SOW checklist. Success check: at least one opportunity carries a non-zero value and Becklar billing drop is confirmed in the portal by 2026-08-25.
